description: Sensor fusion decomposed. Kalman filter math (predict + update), EKF for non-linear, UKF (sigma points), particle filter (Monte Carlo), AHRS (Attitude/Heading Reference), Mahony filter, GNSS-INS fusion, visual-inertial odometry.

sub_mechanisms.name: kalman_predict_step
sub_mechanisms.definition: x' = Fx + Bu (state). P' = FPF^T + Q (covariance). Project state forward in time.
sub_mechanisms.why: Use model to predict where state should be. Q is process noise covariance — how much we trust the model. Foundation of Kalman.

sub_mechanisms.name: kalman_update_step
sub_mechanisms.definition: y = z - Hx (innovation). K = PH^T(HPH^T+R)^-1 (Kalman gain). x = x + Ky; P = (I-KH)P.
sub_mechanisms.why: Combine prediction with measurement. K is weight: more weight on lower-uncertainty source. R is measurement noise.

sub_mechanisms.name: extended_kalman_filter
sub_mechanisms.definition: EKF: linearise non-linear system about current state. Use Jacobians for F + H.
sub_mechanisms.why: Non-linear systems (most real robots). Cost: linearisation introduces error. Most-used non-linear estimator.

sub_mechanisms.name: unscented_kalman_filter
sub_mechanisms.definition: UKF: deterministic sigma points propagated through non-linear function. No Jacobian needed.
sub_mechanisms.why: Better than EKF for highly non-linear. ~2N+1 sigma points propagated. Slightly more compute, better accuracy.

sub_mechanisms.name: particle_filter_resampling
sub_mechanisms.definition: Particles weighted by observation likelihood. Resample: low-weight particles dropped, high-weight replicated.
sub_mechanisms.why: Handles arbitrary distributions. Particle degeneracy: most weight on few particles → resample. Adaptive Monte Carlo Localization classic.

sub_mechanisms.name: AHRS_orientation_estimation
sub_mechanisms.definition: Attitude/Heading Reference. IMU-based orientation estimate. Roll + pitch + yaw.
sub_mechanisms.why: Drones, AR/VR. Fuses accel (low-pass, tilt) + gyro (high-pass, rate) + magnetometer (yaw reference). Standard inertial sensing.

sub_mechanisms.name: Madgwick_Mahony_filters
sub_mechanisms.definition: Simpler than Kalman. Gradient descent (Madgwick) or PI controller (Mahony) on orientation error.
sub_mechanisms.why: Cheap (no matrix inversions). Quaternion-based. Used heavily in DIY drones, fitness trackers. Good enough for most applications.

sub_mechanisms.name: IMU_bias_estimation
sub_mechanisms.definition: Gyro/accel biases drift. EKF estimates as states alongside orientation.
sub_mechanisms.why: Without: bias accumulates → wrong orientation. With: bias estimated, removed. Critical for long-duration operation.

sub_mechanisms.name: GNSS_INS_fusion
sub_mechanisms.definition: GPS + IMU. INS provides high-rate dead reckoning between GPS fixes; GPS bounds drift.
sub_mechanisms.why: Autonomous vehicles, aerospace. GPS: absolute, slow, lossy. INS: relative, fast, drifting. Fusion combines strengths.

sub_mechanisms.name: visual_inertial_odometry
sub_mechanisms.definition: Camera + IMU. Visual features + inertial integration. Foundational for SLAM, AR.
sub_mechanisms.why: iPhone ARKit, drone navigation. IMU short-term, camera long-term. Tightly-coupled (joint optimisation) vs loosely-coupled.

sub_mechanisms.name: complementary_filter_quaternion
sub_mechanisms.definition: Quaternion blend of integrated gyro + accel/mag corrected attitude. q = a*q_gyro + (1-a)*q_acc_mag.
sub_mechanisms.why: Simple + cheap. No Kalman matrices. Used in millions of fitness wearables. Tune a for trust ratio.

sub_mechanisms.name: outlier_rejection_chi_squared
sub_mechanisms.definition: Test innovation magnitude against chi-squared distribution. Reject measurements beyond threshold.
sub_mechanisms.why: GPS multipath, IMU jolt. Single bad measurement throws off estimate. Outlier rejection keeps filter healthy.

derivation_rules.name: Kalman_optimal_for_Gaussian_linear
if: system + measurements have Gaussian noise + are linear
then: Kalman filter is the optimal Bayesian estimator
derivation_rules.why: Mathematically provable: minimum variance among unbiased estimators. Other approaches (complementary, particle) approximate or generalise.

derivation_rules.name: EKF_acceptable_for_mild_nonlinearity
if: non-linearity is mild around operating point
derivation_rules.why: Linearisation valid in small neighbourhood. Highly non-linear: UKF, particle filter. Most robotics: EKF good enough.

derivation_rules.name: particle_filter_for_multimodal_distributions
if: state could be in multiple distinct regions (multimodal)
derivation_rules.why: Robot localisation: 'somewhere in left corridor OR right corridor'. Kalman: single Gaussian, can't represent. Particles: each in different mode.

derivation_rules.name: bias_estimation_required_for_long_duration
then: bias drift must be estimated + removed
derivation_rules.why: Gyro bias: deg/hr drift. Integrated: 100m position error after 1 hour. Bias estimation as filter state. Required for GNSS-INS, AR longevity.

derivation_rules.name: outlier_rejection_protects_filter_health
derivation_rules.why: GPS multipath, IMU jerks, vision feature mismatches. One bad measurement: filter goes off. Chi-squared rejection: skip outliers; filter stays valid.
